title: Calibrated Order-Randomized Rosenblatt Tests
abstract: arXiv:2609.37477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We test whether a multivariate vector X conforms to a specified distribution F, a problem in copula modelling and density forecasting. The Rosenblatt transform reduces it to a test of uniformity, but depends on an arbitrary coordinate ordering that strongly affects power under dependence. We study order randomization: applying the transform under many random orderings and merging the evidence with dependence-robust rules. Reordering conserves the total Mahalanobis signal energy and merely redistributes it, so one ordering is a lucky or unlucky draw. In simulations we observe significant gains in calibrated power over both the expected single random ordering and order-invariant references. Two ingredients are essential: a two-sided base statistic, and a re-estimating parametric bootstrap that restores level under an estimated null and unlocks the gain. The calibrated pooled tests are robust to the departure's shape; no order-invariant r

translated_title: 校准的顺序随机化Rosenblatt检验
translated_abstract: 我们检验多元向量X是否符合指定的分布F，这是copula建模和密度预测中的一个基本问题。Rosenblatt变换将该问题简化为均匀性检验，但它依赖于任意的坐标排序，在变量存在相关性时，这种排序会强烈影响检验的功效。我们研究顺序随机化方法：在多个随机排序下应用该变换，并使用对相关性稳健的规则合并证据。重新排序会保持总的马氏信号能量不变，仅仅是对其进行重新分配，因此某一种特定排序可能幸运也可能不幸。在模拟中，我们观察到校准功效相比预期的单一随机排序和顺序不变的基准方法都有显著提升。两个要素必不可少：一是双侧的基础统计量，二是重新估计的参数自助法，它在估计的原假设下恢复检验水平并解锁这一增益。校准的合并检验对偏离形状具有稳健性；没有顺序不变的...
tldr: 该论文提出在多个随机坐标排序下应用Rosenblatt变换并用相关性稳健规则合并证据，从而显著提升多元分布拟合检验的校准功效，其关键在于双侧基础统计量和重新估计的参数自助法这两个要素。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that applying the Rosenblatt transform under many random coordinate orderings and merging evidence with dependence-robust rules significantly improves calibrated power for multivariate goodness-of-fit testing, with two essential ingredients: a two-sided base statistic and a re-estimating parametric bootstrap.
